opportunities.title: Diya Sales Boost Campaign
opportunities.description: I’m ready to turn our “Pass the Diya” offer into fast-moving sales and need a marketer who knows how to make WhatsApp work like a storefront. The single objective is crystal-clear: move product, not just likes. Here’s what I have and what I’m missing. • A festive Diya bundle, limited-time price and a short window to create urgency. • A WhatsApp Business account with product catalog enabled, but no structured campaign assets, copy, or rollout plan. What I need from you: 1. Persuasive, festival-themed WhatsApp broadcast copy and image/video creatives that feel personal yet professional. 2. A drip-style messaging calendar (broadcast, status, group prompts and 1-to-1 follow-ups) that spans one week, highlights scarcity and nudges to checkout. 3. Quick-response templates for common queries—pricing, delivery, bulk orders—so I can reply in seconds. 4. Recommendations on list segmentation, click-to-chat links, and any WhatsApp Business features that can shorten the path from chat to purchase. Acceptance criteria • Copy is delivered in editable Google Doc, visuals in PNG/MP4, all sized for WhatsApp. • Messaging schedule is timestamped, clearly mapping each piece of content to its objective (tease, remind, close). • Tone stays warm and festive while keeping a direct call-to-action in every touchpoint. If you’ve already driven tangible sales through WhatsApp campaigns, show me quick samples or stats and let’s light this up.

opportunities.title: Sports Mouthguard 3D Redesign
opportunities.description: (No AI) Hi, I’m looking for a 3D/product designer who can modify or recreate an existing mouthguard design. I already have the visual design and branding direction for the product, which I’ll provide as reference images. The main issue I need corrected is the physical shape/proportions of the mouthguard. At the moment, the front section has quite a large/open gap and sits too low. I want the front outer wall/lip to extend higher so that the gap is much more closed, similar to the competitor reference images I’ve attached. However, I don’t want it to become excessively thick or bulky, the overall profile should still look clean, realistic and suitable for an actual sports mouthguard. The GRID design, colour placement and general shape should remain recognisable. The competitor images are mainly references for the **height, coverage and more closed front profile**, rather than something to copy exactly. I’m open to whichever method you think is most appropriate, modifying/rebuilding the existing design or recreating it properly as a new 3D model. Before I hire you, could you please let me know: • Whether you can realistically achieve this from the references provided • How you would approach changing/recreating the shape • Which software you would use (Blender, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Rhino, ZBrush, etc.) • Whether the final model would be properly editable • What files you would deliver (STEP/STL/OBJ/FBX or other appropriate formats) • Whether you can also produce realistic product renders afterwards Please also tell me if you think there is a better way to achieve the shape shown in the references. I’d rather know your actual approach before starting than simply receive a yes.

opportunities.title: B2B Cold Calling Sales Specialist
opportunities.description: Company: Makeitonline E-Commerce Studio (Pluxo Media) Role: B2B Cold Calling & Tele-Sales Specialist Job Type: Freelance / Remote / Project-Based Payout: ₹200 per successful client closing/onboarding (Uncapped Earnings) About the Role Makeitonline E-Commerce Studio is a fast-growing E-Commerce Enablement Agency. We help traditional manufacturers and super-wholesalers (Jewellery, Fashion, & Accessories) launch and scale their Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) stores on Amazon, Flipkart, and Meesho with zero upfront cost. We are looking for a highly persuasive, fluent, and result-driven B2B Cold Calling Specialist to contact factory owners and manufacturers, pitch our zero-risk onboarding model, and successfully close and onboard them. Key ResponsibilitiesConduct outbound cold calls to verified B2B leads (Jewellery Manufacturers & Factory Owners). Present our value proposition using a structured B2B sales pitch (Zero Upfront Cost / Pay-After-Orders model). Identify client bottlenecks (e.g., lack of direct online presence, dull mobile product photos) and pitch our Studio Shoot & Virtual Combo solutions. Handle client objections with confidence and guide them to share 2–3 product sample photos on WhatsApp for a quick demo. Follow up and successfully onboard the client to close the deal. Requirements & QualificationsExcellent Hindi communication skills with a professional, executive tone. Prior experience in B2B Tele-Sales, Cold Calling, or Inside Sales (E-commerce background is a plus).Strong objection-handling, persuasion, and negotiation skills. Self-disciplined, target-driven mindset suitable for remote work. Smartphone and a stable internet connection.Compensation & BenefitsFixed Payout: ₹200 for every successfully closed and onboarded client (paid weekly every Saturday via UPI). Uncapped Earning Potential: No limit on the number of clients you can onboard daily or monthly. Flexible Work Mode: 100% Remote / Work From Home. Growth Opportunity: Priority consideration for long-term fixed retainer roles based on performance.

opportunities.description: Description: We’re a US manufacturer of pneumatic tube and security systems. We need an experienced electrical engineer to help refine the design of a UL-rated power supply that we’re redesigning for a new product series. We also need help producing custom product wiring diagrams. This is a part-time contract of about 10 hours per week for 4 weeks, and it may be extended. Scope of work: Review and refine our existing power supply / control board design Recommend design changes that support UL compliance for the new product series Create or update custom product wiring diagrams Document design decisions and changes clearly so our internal team can pick up the work Required: Proven experience designing AC/DC power supplies or motor control boards Hands-on experience designing products to UL standards and supporting UL certification Ability to produce clean, production-ready wiring diagrams and schematics US-based and available during Central Time business hours Willing to sign an NDA Preferred: Experience with electromechanical equipment (motors, blowers, solenoids, sensors) Experience with [your tools, e.g., Altium, KiCad, AutoCAD Electrical Solid works] To apply, please include: A short summary of historical experience for a power supply or motor control board you designed, including the UL standard involved Examples of wiring diagrams or schematics you’ve produced, with sensitive details removed Your hourly rate and your availability over the next 4 weeks Which design tools you use/prefer

opportunities.title: Commission-based website selling (SALE)
opportunities.description: Find Clients for Web Design Studio (Commission-Based) Description: Wenoy is an independent web studio based in Bangalore, India. We build professional websites for small and medium businesses in India and abroad. We are looking for a Business Development Partner who can bring us paying clients. How you find clients is up to you. Cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, cold calls), your personal network, referrals, social media, walking into local shops, or any other honest method that works for you. What you will do: • Find business owners who need a new website or a redesign (salons, clinics, restaurants, shops, furniture, logistics, etc.) • Reach out to them by cold outreach or any method you prefer • Introduce Wenoy and connect the client with us • Help close the deal What we will do: • Give the quote and finalize the price • Design, build and launch the website • Handle all client support and changes • Share samples of our work to help your pitch Commission (first project only): • India clients: 20% of project value • Foreign clients: 30% of project value Paid after the client has paid us. Rules: • Use honest outreach only. No spam, fake claims or misleading messages. • Do not quote prices or promise features. We handle that. • Share every lead with us before going further, so it is registered under your name. • Terms are confirmed in a short written agreement. Requirements: • Good English communication (Hindi/Kannada/Arabic is a plus) • Experience in sales, cold outreach, lead generation, marketing or freelancing • A network of business owners is a big plus To apply, please answer: 1. Which method will you use to find clients (cold email, LinkedIn, calls, network, other)? 2. Which countries or industries do you know best? 3. Have you sold web or digital services before? Share examples. No investment needed. No fixed target

opportunities.title: Charming 3D Nursery Rhyme Videos
opportunities.description: I need a series of full-length 3D animated nursery rhyme videos designed specifically for babies and toddlers (0–3). Each rhyme should be fully produced from start to finish: you will build the characters and environments in 3D, compose an original, catchy melody, record gentle vocals, and weave in age-appropriate sound effects. My priority is simple, colourful storytelling that keeps very young viewers engaged and soothed. Smooth, slow camera moves, bright yet soft palettes, and clear facial expressions are essential. Audio must be mixed cleanly so the lyrics are easy to follow and the overall volume is comfortable for small ears. Deliverables for each rhyme: • 1920×1080 MP4 video (or higher on request) • Separate WAV stems for music, vocals, and SFX • Source project files for both animation and audio (Blender/Maya, Logic/Pro Tools, etc.) Please include a short note on your workflow, preferred 3D and audio tools, and a link to at least one previous child-focused animation with original music. If you already have sample characters or style frames, feel free to attach them so we can quickly align on look and feel.

opportunities.title: Project Governance & Reporting Standardization
opportunities.description: I need an expert who can bring order and consistency to my scattered project information. At the moment I track some initiatives in Excel, others in Smartsheet, and a few more through Teams and SharePoint. My first priority is to organise and standardise every file, meeting-related document and project process so that reporting later becomes friction-free. Scope of work • Design a clear, repeatable governance framework: common project states, reporting cadence, and approval rules that apply to every portfolio item. • Build the supporting file structure inside SharePoint (or the platform you recommend) and map existing Excel, Smartsheet and Teams content into it with clean naming conventions. • Provide meeting and action-tracking templates that align with the new framework so I can capture notes the same way every time. • Prepare the ground for future automation: your structure must be compatible with Power Automate triggers and ready for a Power BI executive dashboard that will eventually pull from all sources—even when formats differ. • Show me how AI can draft follow-up emails and reminders from the data we capture. Acceptance criteria 1. A documented governance guide covering project states, mandatory reports, and escalation paths. 2. A working folder hierarchy populated with my current files and the agreed naming standards. 3. Ready-to-use templates for meetings, decisions, and action logs. 4. A short demo proving that at least one automation flow (e.g., automatic reminder email) runs successfully against the new structure. 5. Step-by-step instructions so I can maintain and scale the setup on my own. Tools already in use: Microsoft 365 (Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, Planner), Smartsheet, Teams, and plenty of Excel files. If you have solid experience harmonising mixed environments and can keep things lean and pragmatic, I’d like to start right away and move quickly to visible results.

opportunities.title: Land Lead Gen Marketing
opportunities.description: I’m ready to scale sales for our residential and farm-style land plots and I need an experienced digital marketer who has already cracked real-estate lead generation in India. The first campaigns must promote plots in both Indore and Ujjain, so your targeting, copy and creatives should speak to buyers familiar with these cities and their growth corridors. WHO WE’RE TRYING TO REACH • Investors looking for future value growth • People interested in farm or weekend plots WHAT MUST STAND OUT IN EVERY AD & ON THE LANDING PAGE • Price, plot size and clear payment options • Exact location, nearby roads and upcoming development plans • All legal papers, approvals and clean ownership details YOUR CORE TASKS 1. Set up and optimise Meta Ads (Facebook / Instagram) and Google Ads lead campaigns geared toward low cost-per-enquiry. 2. Build or refine a fast, mobile-first landing page that captures leads and syncs to a basic CRM. 3. Implement an instant WhatsApp / phone follow-up flow so leads never go cold. 4. Produce scroll-stopping ad creatives—images, short reels and carousels that suit each placement. 5. Review performance with me every week, adjust targeting, creative and budgets, and keep CPL trending down. TOOLS YOU’LL PROBABLY TOUCH Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, WordPress or Webflow (for the landing page), basic CRM (Zoho, HubSpot or similar), Google Analytics, WhatsApp Business API, Zapier/Make for automation. TIMELINE & ENGAGEMENT This is an ongoing engagement for a minimum of three months; ad spend is separate and funded by me. SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Consistent flow of qualified enquiries from Indore and Ujjain • Clear CPL benchmarks met or beaten each week • Landing page conversion rate trending upward • Smooth WhatsApp hand-off so my sales team can close quickly If you’ve driven plot or real-estate leads before, especially in Madhya Pradesh, send over your best case studies showing leads generated and cost per lead achieved. Let’s talk strategy and get the campaigns live.

opportunities.title: Optimasi Proses Persetujuan Tim
opportunities.description: Saya ingin mempercepat alur persetujuan dan koordinasi antar tim di perusahaan kami. Saat ini, prosesnya masih terfragmentasi—terlalu banyak langkah manual, komunikasi tersebar di beberapa kanal, dan tidak ada jalur yang benar-benar jelas tentang siapa menyetujui apa dan kapan. Akibatnya, pekerjaan tertahan dan target waktu mundur. Saya membutuhkan seorang ahli optimasi proses kerja bisnis yang dapat: • Memetakan alur persetujuan yang berjalan sekarang, lengkap dengan hambatan utamanya. • Merancang proses baru yang lebih ringkas dan terukur, beserta diagram flow atau SOP singkat. • Menyediakan rekomendasi tool digital (mis. workflow automation, project management, atau approval software) yang cocok dengan skala kami. • Menyusun rencana implementasi tahap awal agar tim dapat mulai mengadopsi proses baru tanpa gangguan besar pada operasional harian. Keberhasilan pekerjaan ini diukur dari tercapainya jalur persetujuan yang lebih singkat, transparansi status yang mudah dipantau, serta potensi penghematan waktu nyata bagi tiap tim yang terlibat. Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman merampingkan proses lintas-departemen dan familiar dengan pendekatan continuous improvement seperti Lean, BPMN, atau sejenisnya, saya menantikan solusi praktis Anda.

opportunities.title: YouTube Story-Driven Educational Animations
opportunities.description: I’m building a YouTube channel that teaches concepts through short, narrative-style explainers. Every episode will feel like a mini story: clear beginning, engaging middle, memorable takeaway at the end. I’m flexible on the exact production method as long as it keeps costs sensible and the result looks polished. Simple 2D cartoon scenes with limited movement, motion-comic panels with text and camera moves, or even stock footage enhanced with animated graphics and narration are all options I’m willing to explore. If you prefer working in Toon Boom, After Effects, Blender, or a comparable pipeline, that’s fine with me—choose the tools that let you move quickly without sacrificing clarity. What I need from you for each video • A complete, royalty-free animated file (1080p) ready to upload • Background music and sound effects blended at broadcast levels • One round of revisions after I review the first cut Scripts and voice-over can be provided or handled by you—let me know which arrangement you prefer when you respond. If you have a sample that shows how you turn an educational idea into a compelling story, include the link so I can see your pacing and visual style in action.

opportunities.title: Auto-Save WhatsApp Documents
opportunities.description: I need a lightweight solution that quietly watches my WhatsApp account and, the moment a PDF, Word file, spreadsheet, or similar document arrives, copies it straight into a dedicated folder on my computer—no photos, no videos, only documents. The job is purely “receive and save,” so there is no need to send messages back or organise files by date; a clean dump into the folder is fine. I’m flexible on how you achieve this (Python using the WhatsApp Web session, a small desktop utility, or the official Business API if you already have it wired up), as long as it runs reliably on Windows and can start up automatically with the machine. Deliverables • Working script / executable with clear setup instructions • Brief read-me showing how I can point it to a different folder later • Short note on dependencies or required libraries I’ll test by sending a couple of PDFs and DOCX files; if they land in the folder without manual steps, we’re done.

opportunities.title: Cinematic 3D Perfume Ad Video
opportunities.description: I need a short, cinematic product video that makes our new perfume feel as luxurious as it smells. The key objective is to visually highlight the fragrance’s signature ingredients and scent notes—think elegant macro shots or artistic 3D particle reveals that let viewers almost “sense” the aroma on screen. The overall look should stay bright, clean, and unmistakably high-end. Picture pristine white or light-toned environments, subtle reflections, and refined lighting that glides across the glass without ever feeling harsh. Gold accents, deep shadows, or dreamy haze won’t fit the brand; crisp sophistication will. Scope of work • Build or refine a photorealistic 3D model of the bottle (I can supply CAD, reference photos, and label artwork). • Create ingredient visualizations—citrus zest bursting, petals unfolding, droplets swirling—matching the scent profile I’ll provide. • Assemble a 15–30 second edit with cinematic camera moves, tasteful typography for the note callouts, and music or sound design that complements the light, fresh mood. • Deliver the final video in 4K (landscape) plus an optimized square or vertical cutdown ready for social media. Acceptance criteria • Bottle materials, liquid, and reflections must look realistic at 4K. • Ingredient animations clearly correspond to each note I specify. • Color palette stays bright, clean, and elegant throughout. • Final files include the master video, an editable project file (Cinema 4D/Blender + After Effects or similar), and a high-quality h.264 export. If you have past work showcasing luxury products with a similar polished aesthetic, please share it when you bid. Looking forward to collaborating and bringing our fragrance to life on screen.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Customer Chat Support Admin
opportunities.description: My WhatsApp Business line receives a steady stream of inquiries each day, and I need every message answered quickly, clearly, and politely. The bulk of the chats revolve around three recurring themes: price and stock availability, how to place an order and complete payment, and shipping information or tracking updates. Your entire focus is to keep these customers informed and confident enough to proceed with their purchase. That means: • Responding in real-time during the agreed working hours—no unanswered or ignored chats. • Providing accurate, up-to-date details on product availability and current prices. • Guiding buyers step-by-step through my existing ordering and payment process. • Checking shipping data in our system and relaying status updates or estimated arrival times. I will supply a concise FAQ, product catalogue and access to our courier portal so you can verify tracking numbers on the spot. Any question you cannot resolve should be noted and forwarded to me immediately. Deliverables accepted as complete each day: 1. All incoming WhatsApp messages handled within the promised response window. 2. A short end-of-shift summary listing total chats, common questions, and any issues escalated. Fluent written Indonesian and a friendly tone are essential. Let’s keep customers happy and sales flowing smoothly.

opportunities.title: Asisten Chat WhatsApp Bisnis
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk menangani komunikasi pelanggan di akun WhatsApp Business saya. Fokus utama pekerjaan ini adalah membalas chat dan komentar dengan cepat, ramah, dan akurat agar pengalaman pelanggan tetap positif. Tanggung jawab utama: • Menjawab semua chat masuk di WhatsApp Business sesuai pedoman brand dan bahasa yang sopan. • Menyaring pertanyaan yang berulang, lalu memberikan jawaban standar atau meneruskan kasus khusus kepada saya. • Mencatat pertanyaan, keluhan, dan saran pelanggan ke lembar kerja Google Sheets sederhana agar mudah saya tinjau. • Memberi laporan ringkas setiap akhir hari tentang jumlah chat yang ditangani, isu penting, dan tindak lanjut yang diperlukan. Kualifikasi yang saya butuhkan: • Terbiasa menggunakan WhatsApp Business (fitur label, quick-reply, dan broadcast). • Responsif—idealnya mampu membalas dalam waktu maksimal 10 menit selama jam kerja yang kita sepakati. • Komunikatif dalam bahasa Indonesia yang baik dan benar, santun, serta tetap ramah. • Teliti dalam mencatat data pelanggan dan ringkasan interaksi. Silakan jelaskan pengalaman Anda menangani chat pelanggan, perkiraan ketersediaan harian, serta contoh pendek bagaimana Anda akan menjawab pertanyaan “Kapan pesanan saya dikirim?”. Saya menantikan kolaborasi yang lancar sehingga pelanggan merasa terlayani dengan baik.

opportunities.title: Photorealistic Industrial Plant CGI Animation
opportunities.description: # Photorealistic Industrial Plant CGI Rendering & Cinematic 3D Animation ## Project Overview We are an engineering company looking for an experienced 3D visualization artist or CGI studio to create high-quality photorealistic images and cinematic video animations of an industrial processing plant. We already have: - A complete 3D model of the industrial plant. - Reference drone videos showing the actual plant, its surroundings and overall appearance. - Technical information and reference materials. The objective is to transform our existing 3D model into highly realistic visual content that looks like professional industrial photography and real aerial drone footage. **No plant design or engineering work is required.** The main task is 3D visualization, rendering, lighting, texturing and animation. ## Scope of Work ### 1. Photorealistic CGI Images Create approximately 8–12 high-quality photorealistic images, including: - Aerial views of the complete industrial facility. - Drone-style perspective views from different angles. - Ground-level views of the facility. - Close-up views of industrial equipment, tanks, pipes and structures. - Architectural and industrial detail shots. The images should look like real professional photographs, not conventional 3D renders. ### 2. Cinematic 3D Video Animation Create a cinematic 3D animation of the industrial facility, approximately 45–60 seconds long. The video should include: - Realistic drone-style camera movements. - Aerial flyovers and orbit shots around the facility. - Smooth transitions between different camera angles. - Close-up shots of selected equipment and technical details. - Realistic lighting, shadows, reflections, materials and environmental surroundings. The final result should resemble high-end industrial promotional footage filmed with a professional drone. ### 3. Visual Style Our preferred visual direction: - Photorealistic industrial visualization. - Cinematic commercial photography. - Realistic materials and textures. - Natural daylight and atmospheric lighting. - Professional engineering and industrial presentation. - Premium, clean and modern visual appearance. The reference drone footage will be used to match the actual facility, camera angles, environment and proportions. ## Technical Requirements - Final images: 4K resolution or higher. - Video: 4K UHD (3840 × 2160). - Video format: MP4, H.264 or H.265. - Smooth cinematic camera animation. - Professional color grading. - High-quality rendering with realistic materials and lighting. ## Required Freelancer Experience Please apply only if you have experience in: - Industrial 3D visualization. - Photorealistic CGI rendering. - Architectural and industrial animation. - Working with existing engineering CAD/3D models. - Creating realistic drone-style 3D camera animations. Experience with Blender, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, V-Ray, Corona or similar software is welcome. ## What to Include in Your Proposal Please provide: 1. Portfolio examples of photorealistic industrial facilities. 2. Examples of industrial 3D animations or drone-style CGI videos. 3. Your proposed workflow and software. 4. Estimated production time. 5. Fixed price for the complete project. 6. Confirmation that you can work with our existing 3D model. **Important:** We are looking for a long-term cooperation with a talented 3D visualization artist or studio for future industrial projects. Please submit relevant portfolio examples rather than general 3D artwork.

observed_data.verbatim_request: "# Photorealistic Industrial Plant CGI Rendering & Cinematic 3D Animation ## Project Overview We are an engineering company looking for an experienced 3D visualization artist or CGI studio to create high-quality photorealistic images and cinematic video animations of an industrial processing plant. We already have: - A complete 3D model of the industrial plant. - Reference drone videos showing the actual plant, its surroundings and overall appearance. - Technical information and reference materials. The objective is to transform our existing 3D model into highly realistic visual content that looks like professional industrial photography and real aerial drone footage. **No plant design or engineering work is required.** The main task is 3D visualization, rendering, lighting, texturing and animation. ## Scope of Work ### 1. Photorealistic CGI Images Create approximately 8–12 high-quality photorealistic images, including: - Aerial views of the complete industrial facility. - Drone-style perspective views from different angles. - Ground-level views of the facility. - Close-up views of industrial equipment, tanks, pipes and structures. - Architectural and industrial detail shots. The images should look like real professional photographs, not conventional 3D renders. ### 2. Cinematic 3D Video Animation Create a cinematic 3D animation of the industrial facility, approximately 45–60 seconds long. The video should include: - Realistic drone-style camera movements. - Aerial flyovers and orbit shots around the facility. - Smooth transitions between different camera angles. - Close-up shots of selected equipment and technical details. - Realistic lighting, shadows, reflections, materials and environmental surroundings. The final result should resemble high-end industrial promotional footage filmed with a professional drone. ### 3. Visual Style Our preferred visual direction: - Photorealistic industrial visualization. - Cinematic commercial photography. - Realistic materials and textures. - Natural daylight and atmospheric lighting. - Professional engineering and industrial presentation. - Premium, clean and modern visual appearance. The reference drone footage will be used to match the actual facility, camera angles, environment and proportions. ## Technical Requirements - Final images: 4K resolution or higher. - Video: 4K UHD (3840 × 2160). - Video format: MP4, H.264 or H.265. - Smooth cinematic camera animation. - Professional color grading. - High-quality rendering with realistic materials and lighting. ## Required Freelancer Experience Please apply only if you have experience in: - Industrial 3D visualization. - Photorealistic CGI rendering. - Architectural and industrial animation. - Working with existing engineering CAD/3D models. - Creating realistic drone-style 3D camera animations. Experience with Blender, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, V-Ray, Corona or similar software is welcome. ## What to Include in Your Proposal Please provide: 1. Portfolio examples of photorealistic industrial facilities. 2. Examples of industrial 3D animations or drone-style CGI videos. 3. Your proposed workflow and software. 4. Estimated production time. 5. Fixed price for the complete project. 6. Confirmation that you can work with our existing 3D model. **Important:** We are looking for a long-term cooperation with a talented 3D visualization artist or studio for future industrial projects. Please submit relevant portfolio examples rather than general 3D artwork."

opportunities.title: Record 1.5-Hour Persian Dialogues
opportunities.description: I need several native Iranian Persian speakers to capture around 90 minutes of clean, natural everyday conversation. The audio will be used strictly for ASR evaluation, so authenticity and clarity matter more than studio-grade polish. Here is the flow: • Pair up with a friend or relative and hold unscripted conversations on ordinary topics (daily life, hobbies, news, etc.) for 45 minutes. Then record 45 minutes of solo dialogue. • Any common Iranian Persian accent is welcome—Tehrani, Shirazi, Isfahani, you name it—as long as it is recognisably Iranian and consistent within the session. • Record in a quiet room with a good phone mic or external recorder (16-bit, 44.1 kHz WAV preferred). Avoid background noise, music, or overlapping speech. • Break the session into files of 5–10 minutes each, name them clearly, and deliver the raw WAVs plus a simple log of participants, date, and topics discussed. Deliverables: 1. 45 minutes of conversational audio per speaker (approx. 4 × 10-minute WAV files). 2. 45 minutes of solo recording per speaker (approx. 5 × 10-minute WAV files). 3. Session log in plain text or Excel. Metadata creation and transcription will be handled by our bot. Payments will be made via Freelancer. I will run a quick quality check—if speech is clear, free of clipping, and matches the guidelines, I release payment immediately. Looking forward to hearing genuine voices from across Iran.

opportunities.title: Local Business Finder App
opportunities.description: SIAHA CITY DIRECTORY ANDROID MOBILE APPLICATION – DEVELOPMENT REQUIREMENTS Project: Digital Yellow Pages Directory for Siaha, Mizoram Platform: Android (Google Play Store) Maximum Development Budget: ₹10,000 Application Type: Lightweight, Offline-First Directory App 1. PROJECT OBJECTIVE Develop a simple, clean, lightweight and user-friendly Android application named SIAHA CITY DIRECTORY, similar to a traditional Yellow Pages directory. The application will help residents of Siaha, Mizoram, easily find contact information for government offices, schools, hospitals, NGOs, shops, businesses, service providers and other local organisations. The priority is simplicity, fast performance, offline accessibility, stability, security and affordability. No complicated or expensive features are required. 2. MAIN FEATURES & CATEGORIES The application should include the following categories: Government Offices and Departments Schools and Educational Institutions Hospitals and Healthcare Centres NGOs and Associations Shops and Local Businesses Professional Service Providers Public Services Other Organisations Each listing should contain: Unique ID Category Organisation / Office / Business Name Person's Name Designation Contact Number WhatsApp Number Address / Location Active / Inactive Status Optional information should be hidden when unavailable. 3. SEARCH & CONTACT FUNCTIONALITY Users must be able to search by organisation name, office name, person's name, designation, contact number, business name and category. Required features: Category-wise browsing. Office-wise searching. Designation-wise searching. Partial keyword searching. Fast and accurate search results. Every listing should have: CALL: Opens the Android phone dialler with the contact number. WHATSAPP: Opens a WhatsApp conversation with the listed number. No user login or registration should be required. 4. EXCEL-BASED DATA MANAGEMENT The owner must be able to manage all directory information through Microsoft Excel without programming knowledge. The developer must provide a standard Excel (.xlsx) template with fixed column headings. The owner should be able to add, edit, update, deactivate and remove directory listings through Excel. Required update workflow: Owner updates the Excel file. Excel data is converted into structured JSON through a reusable process. Updated JSON is uploaded to a simple online hosting service. The app automatically checks for new data when internet is available. Updated information is downloaded and stored locally. All users receive the latest directory information without reinstalling the app or updating it through the Play Store. Important: Excel must remain the primary data-entry format. Owner should not need to edit JSON or source code. Every listing must have a unique ID. Provide an easy, documented upload and conversion process. Invalid or incomplete updates must not replace existing valid data. Include an optional manual refresh button. Avoid unnecessary downloads when no data has changed. A complicated admin dashboard or custom backend is not required. 5. MANDATORY OFFLINE FUNCTIONALITY The application MUST work completely offline after installation and initial directory data download. On first launch, the app should download the directory database and save it permanently in the phone's local storage. Without internet, users must be able to: Open and browse the application. View all downloaded categories. Search offices, schools, hospitals and businesses. Search by names and designations. View contact numbers and addresses. Access previously downloaded directory information. Close and reopen the app without losing data. Restart the phone and continue using the directory. The CALL button should work offline by opening the phone dialler, although actual calls require mobile network connectivity. WhatsApp messaging requires internet. Offline data protection: Retain the previous database if internet is unavailable. Never delete existing data before a new dataset is successfully downloaded and validated. The application must continue working if the hosting service is temporarily unavailable. Online synchronisation must not interrupt offline searching. Mandatory acceptance test: Install the app, download the initial database, turn off Wi-Fi and mobile data, close and reopen the app, search multiple categories, view contact details and restart the phone. All downloaded directory and search features must continue working. 6. DESIGN & PERFORMANCE The application should have: Clean, modern and professional interface. Simple navigation and category icons. Easy-to-read fonts. Lightweight installation size. Fast loading and searching. Minimal RAM and storage consumption. Compatibility with commonly used Android devices. No unnecessary animations or heavy graphics. Stable performance without frequent crashes. 7. SECURITY & RELIABILITY Use HTTPS for online data delivery. Validate downloaded JSON data before applying updates. Maintain a backup of the last valid local database. Use unique listing IDs. Avoid unnecessary permissions and data collection. No unnecessary advertisements or tracking. Provide maintainable source code. Use proper Android application signing. The application should be suitable for long-term use with routine maintenance. 8. RECOMMENDED TECHNOLOGY The developer may choose the most economical and suitable technology. Preferred options: Android App: Flutter or Kotlin. Local Database: SQLite / Room. Data Entry: Microsoft Excel. Data Delivery: JSON. Online Hosting: Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, Firebase Hosting or equivalent. Synchronisation: Version-based JSON update checking. Use a lightweight offline-first architecture. Expensive servers and paid database subscriptions are not required for the initial version. 9. GOOGLE PLAY STORE PUBLISHING The developer must provide: Signed Android App Bundle (AAB). APK installation file. Application icon and basic branding. Play Store screenshots and description. Publishing assistance. The app must be published under the owner's own Google Play Console account. 10. PROJECT DELIVERABLES The developer must hand over: Fully functional Android application. Complete editable source code. Signed AAB and APK files. Standard Excel data entry template. Reusable Excel-to-JSON conversion process. Online hosting configuration and ownership/access details. opportunities.title: RCC Structural Design Engineer Required – G+2 Villa with Transfer Beams & Discontinuous Column Grids
opportunities.description: Project: G+2 Residential Villa Location: Goa, India Soil Safe Bearing Capacity (SBC): 18 tonnes/m² (approximately 176.5 kN/m²) Design Codes: Applicable Indian Standards Preferred Software: ETABS, SAFE and AutoCAD Project Description We require an experienced Structural Engineer for the complete RCC structural analysis, design and detailing of a G+2 residential villa. The principal design challenge is that the structural column grids differ between the ground, first and second floors, resulting in discontinuous vertical load paths. The structural design may require transfer beams, floating or stub columns, and suitable alternative framing arrangements to accommodate the architectural layout. Scope of Work 1. Review the architectural plans and establish an appropriate structural framing scheme. 2. Design the transfer beam system and discontinuous column arrangements. 3. Develop the complete structural analysis model in ETABS. 4. Design RCC beams, columns, slabs, staircases and foundations. 5. Design foundations considering an SBC of 18 tonnes/m², subject to confirmation of its applicability at the proposed founding depth. 6. Perform gravity, seismic and wind load analysis under applicable Indian Standards. 7. Check transfer beam shear, bending, torsion, deflection and reinforcement anchorage. 8. Prepare complete structural drawings and reinforcement detailing. Required Deliverables * Editable ETABS structural model. * SAFE foundation model, where applicable. * Structural analysis and design calculation report. * Foundation and column layout drawings. * Floor-wise RCC framing plans. * Transfer beam and supported-column reinforcement details. * Beam, slab, column and staircase reinforcement drawings. * Bar Bending Schedule (BBS). Engineer Requirements Applicants must have proven experience in RCC structural design involving floating columns, transfer beams and vertically irregular structures. Please provide relevant project examples, professional fees, proposed methodology and estimated completion timeline.

raw_data.verbatim_request: "Project: G+2 Residential Villa Location: Goa, India Soil Safe Bearing Capacity (SBC): 18 tonnes/m² (approximately 176.5 kN/m²) Design Codes: Applicable Indian Standards Preferred Software: ETABS, SAFE and AutoCAD Project Description We require an experienced Structural Engineer for the complete RCC structural analysis, design and detailing of a G+2 residential villa. The principal design challenge is that the structural column grids differ between the ground, first and second floors, resulting in discontinuous vertical load paths. The structural design may require transfer beams, floating or stub columns, and suitable alternative framing arrangements to accommodate the architectural layout. Scope of Work 1. Review the architectural plans and establish an appropriate structural framing scheme. 2. Design the transfer beam system and discontinuous column arrangements. 3. Develop the complete structural analysis model in ETABS. 4. Design RCC beams, columns, slabs, staircases and foundations. 5. Design foundations considering an SBC of 18 tonnes/m², subject to confirmation of its applicability at the proposed founding depth. 6. Perform gravity, seismic and wind load analysis under applicable Indian Standards. 7. Check transfer beam shear, bending, torsion, deflection and reinforcement anchorage. 8. Prepare complete structural drawings and reinforcement detailing. Required Deliverables * Editable ETABS structural model. * SAFE foundation model, where applicable. * Structural analysis and design calculation report. * Foundation and column layout drawings. * Floor-wise RCC framing plans. * Transfer beam and supported-column reinforcement details. * Beam, slab, column and staircase reinforcement drawings. * Bar Bending Schedule (BBS). Engineer Requirements Applicants must have proven experience in RCC structural design involving floating columns, transfer beams and vertically irregular structures. Please provide relevant project examples, professional fees, proposed methodology and estimated completion timeline."

opportunities.title: Automate Your Workflows with AI
opportunities.description: I'm an engineer who helps businesses save time by automating repetitive work with n8n and AI. Instead of your team answering the same customer questions, copying data between tools, or chasing leads by hand, I build workflows that do it automatically, 24/7. WHAT I CAN BUILD FOR YOU: • AI chatbots and agents that answer customer questions using your own data (RAG) • Workflows that connect your tools: WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Sheets, CRMs, and any API • Lead capture, order handling, and follow-up automation • Document and data processing with LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, and open-source models) • Self-hosted setups with Docker for businesses that want to keep their data private EXAMPLE USE CASES: • A restaurant assistant that answers questions about the menu, prices, and opening hours • A clinic or service business bot that collects booking requests and sends them to a Google Sheet • An email workflow that reads incoming messages, sorts them, and drafts replies for your approval HOW I WORK: 1. I start by understanding your process and what's costing you the most time. 2. I build a clean workflow with proper error handling, so it doesn't fail silently. 3. I show you a working demo before delivery and explain everything in simple language. 4. I document the workflow so you or your team can maintain it later. RECENT WORK: I built a RAG-based AI assistant that answers questions from a restaurant's menu and business data, using n8n, Gemini embeddings, a local LLM through Ollama, and a Docker setup. TOOLS: n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, Docker, REST APIs, Google Workspace If you have a task your team repeats every day, send me a message with a short description and I'll tell you honestly whether it can be automated and how long it would take. I focus on results, not just delivering a workflow.

opportunities.title: Plataforma de comercio inmersivo en metaverso
opportunities.description: Estoy trabajando en una plataforma inmersiva que busca revolucionar el comercio digital. Este mundo digital permitirá a los usuarios crear y personalizar sus propias tiendas virtuales como si fueran mundos, estableciendo sus reglas únicas y ofreciendo todo tipo de productos para vender y comprar. La plataforma incluirá: - Creación de tiendas virtuales completamente personalizables con plantillas, escaparates dinámicos y herramientas de analítica básica. - Flujos avanzados de compra-venta, gestión de inventarios y una pasarela de pagos virtual integrada. - Experiencias sociales, incluyendo interacción entre avatares, chat de voz y gestos con seguimiento manual. - Compatibilidad multiplataforma para dispositivos WebXR, Meta Quest, HTC Vive, PCVR optimizados con motores como Unity o Unreal Engine. Busco soporte técnico para construir este sistema. Entrego wireframes iniciales y listado de funcionalidades clave. Necesito código limpio, documentación bien detallada e informes técnicos sobre las especificaciones del proyecto. ¡Si tienes experiencia similar será un plus!

opportunities.title: Asistente WhatsApp Atención a Clientes
opportunities.description: Quiero implementar un asistente virtual en WhatsApp Business que atienda las consultas diarias de mis clientes de forma automática y, cuando detecte un caso complejo, lo redirija a un operador humano sin perder el historial de la conversación. Qué debe hacer el asistente • Reconocer preguntas habituales y responderlas en el mismo hilo. • Consultar la información de cada cliente sobre pedidos, reservas o citas para dar detalles de estado, horarios o cambios. • Escalar cualquier consulta fuera de lo previsto a un número o chat interno con un agente humano, indicando el motivo y adjuntando el contexto. Fuente de datos disponible Toda la información de pedidos y reservas está dispersa en las propias conversaciones de WhatsApp o en registros manuales. Necesito una propuesta que extraiga esos datos de manera estructurada o, si lo prefieres, plantee una forma sencilla de que yo alimente al bot con esa información (por ejemplo, mediante etiquetas, mensajes con formato o una pequeña base externa). Entrego • Ejemplos de conversaciones reales para entrenar al bot. • Lista de respuestas modelo y reglas de escalamiento que ya utilizo manualmente. Espero • Configuración completa en la plataforma que sugieras (WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, ManyChat, Dialogflow, etc.). • Entrenamiento inicial y documentación breve para que pueda ajustar nuevas FAQs. • Pruebas funcionen en español con casos reales y demostración de la derivación a humano. • Breve guía de mantenimiento y soporte para los primeros ajustes. Si tienes experiencia previa creando chatbots o integraciones en WhatsApp y puedes trabajar con la información no estructurada que describo, me encantará conocer tu enfoque y tiempo estimado.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40808882, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 8 - 15.

opportunities.title: Mystery Shopper Telefónico Restaurantes CDMX
opportunities.description: Busco a alguien que realice llamadas de incógnito a distintos restaurantes y cafeterías dentro de la Ciudad de México y su zona metropolitana. El objetivo es evaluar, de forma discreta, cómo capturan los pedidos y los datos del cliente cuando se solicita un pedido sencillo del menú. Qué necesito: • De 10 a 15 llamadas distribuidas entre varios establecimientos que yo proporcionaré. • Registro detallado por llamada: fecha, hora, nombre del negocio, nombre del operador (si se proporciona) y transcripción breve. • Evaluación clara sobre la toma correcta de pedidos y datos (exactitud, repetición del pedido, confirmación de dirección o número de contacto, etc.). • Archivo de resultados en Google Sheets o Excel, más un comentario final con hallazgos generales y recomendaciones. Detalles clave: • El foco está únicamente en la fase de “Toma correcta de pedidos y datos”. No es necesario valorar amabilidad, tiempos de espera ni otros factores, salvo que afecten directamente a esa toma. • Todas las llamadas deben plantear pedidos sencillos del menú, sin cambios especiales ni órdenes grandes. • Las conversaciones deben mantenerse naturales; no reveles que se trata de una evaluación. • La información recopilada será de uso interno y confidencial. Entrego lista de números y un guion sugerido. Solo necesito las grabaciones (si tu equipo lo permite) y el reporte completo en un plazo máximo de una semana después de la adjudicación.

opportunities.title: Interior Designer Needed: 3D Renderings, Finish Schedule & Dimensional Layouts
opportunities.description: I am looking for a talented junior-to-intermediate interior designer or high-end e-designer to handle the aesthetic design for a large residential project. The project includes 9 major zones: • 1 Great Room • 1 Main Kitchen • 1 Spice Kitchen • 6 Washrooms I already have a seasoned builder executing the project to code and handles all structural/technical elements. I will provide you with the complete architectural floor plans in both PDF and CAD format. Your job will be strictly focused on the interior aesthetics, visual space planning, and material selections. Required Deliverables: 1. 3D Renderings: High-quality, photo-realistic 3D visual renderings (2–3 angles per room) showing the design concept. The style must be clean Modern or warm Transitional. 2. Detailed Finish Schedule: A comprehensive spreadsheet detailing all paint selections, flooring, tile placement, countertops, cabinet styles, and decorative lighting fixtures with clickable sourcing links. 3. Dimensional Layouts & Elevations: Using my CAD files, you must provide the precise aesthetic dimensions for the builder. This includes cabinet heights/widths, fireplace feature wall layout dimensions, and tile layout maps for the washrooms so the trades know exactly where to install materials.

Nos dedicamos a productos industriales o empresariales y necesitamos reforzar la presencia en ferias regionales y el contacto directo con distribuidores, mayoristas y comercios. El trabajo se extiende hasta 2027, de modo que valoro la constancia y la visión a largo plazo. Funciones del puesto: .Antes de la feria: llamar a los clientes potenciales Durante cada feria: recopilar los datos de posibles clientes con rigor y orden. • Después del evento: llamar a cada prospecto para presentar la empresa y pactar una reunión. • En la fase de cierre: visitar al cliente cuando sea necesario para afianzar la relación y avanzar en la negociación. Visitar los mercados locales en busca de clientes potenciales Perfil que encaja Eres meticuloso, sereno y analítico; disfrutas del trato telefónico y presencial; manejas tu propio calendario y cuidas cada seguimiento en un CRM o en hojas de cálculo compartidas. Experiencia previa en ventas B2B es indispensable. Si vives en una de las ciudades indicadas y quieres crecer conmigo en este mercado industrial, espero tu propuesta detallando tu experiencia específica y la disponibilidad para viajar dentro de tu región cuando se requiera."

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de módulo Zigisk para MLBB
opportunities.description: Quiero crear un módulo zigisk para usar en un móvil con root o una apk modificada para usar cheats en el juego mlbb en android que sea Segura e indetectable. Quiero que me enseñen a actualizarla para que siga siendo indetectable con las actualizaciones oficiales del juego con un Menú con cosas como maphack en el minimapa o autocombo de habilidades de un personaje . Tengo un módulo desactualizado que usé pero requiere de validación externa y una apk que también funcionaba pero lo mismo requiere de credenciales externas por si sirve de base para crear lo que quiero os lo daré . Me gustaría crear lo más Seguro posible , tengo entendido que es más indetectable el módulo que el apk modificado pero si es igual de seguro lo que sea más sencillo y cómodo de actualizar posteriormente
